aliases.SANDBOX_PROJECT: GCP project used for the run (appears verbatim in transcripts)
aliases.GCP_TEST_IDENTITY: gcloud account used by the Deployer (personal email; do not repeat)
aliases.GH_IDENTITY: GitHub CLI account signed in on the machine (personal; do not repeat)
aliases.OWNER: the human approver in the Deployer session
aliases.RUN_HOST: public hostname requested in the brief
aliases.RESOURCE_X: first billable resource at the forced interrupt (static external address)
aliases.ACCEPTANCE_OBJECT: Owner-created project named <OWNER_ACCEPTANCE_TOKEN> used for the restart check
